research.title: The SonarQube Remediation Agent now fixes Hunter Agent findings
research.summary: In August, SonarQube Hunter Agent became generally available on SonarQube Cloud, giving teams a way to find the security flaws that pattern-based analysis misses. Broken access control, business logic flaws, and gaps in authentication and session handling.
